projections.note: Every coding issue of the build, exactly: one per withheld period, with that period's window. ADJ, YDUP, SPLIT, EQ and DUPS have none (the old tests' `issues == ()`).

test_butsatt_source_blocks_withhold_the_1982_to_1988_overlap: one sheet relabels code 2 (Till barnklinik / Till annan adress) over 1982-1988, so only those years are withheld; the 1990 state ends 1990-12-31 with exactly codes 1-3. The other rows follow from the sheet's blocks.
test_adjacent_dated_labels_for_one_code_keep_both_periods: adjacent dated labels of one code are a label history, not a conflict.

test_same_sheet_year_independent_conflicting_labels_withhold_coding[year_independent] (YIND: two undated labels of 16310 withhold the whole occurrence) and [intervals] (YDATE: the dated relabel withholds only 2020; the years beside it keep the undated label).
test_same_sheet_identical_year_independent_duplicates_are_harmless: a repeated identical row is one member.

test_missing_code_or_label_withholds_complete_list_only_where_member_applies[001-None] (NOLABEL: the blank label withholds the list only in 2020, where that member applies) and test_unknown_or_pooled_code_scope_cannot_be_filled_from_occurrence_year[unknown] (UNK: a member with a malformed period is not filled from the occurrence years, so the list is withheld throughout).

test_code_validity_splits_real_calendar_periods_without_annual_widening (SPLIT: a member valid only in 2020 cuts the occurrence into [0], [0, 1], [0]) and test_no_active_members_reports_missing_coding_and_keeps_occurrence_coverage (EMPTY: the year with no active member keeps its state, uncoded, beside the coded years).

test_equivalent_independent_lists_agree_without_losing_their_references (EQ: two sheets with equal members, one repeating a row, publish one list and no issue) and test_conflicting_lists_withhold_only_the_contested_coding_period[rival0..2]: a second list naming code 2 beside 1 (RIVBOTH), 2 instead of 1 (RIVCODE) or 1 under another label (RIVLABEL) in 2020 withholds only 2020. This is the harder, period-bounded form of coding-competing-lists-without-choice-publish-no-value-set.

test_exact_codes_labels_duplicates_and_occurrence_evidence_survive and test_non_sheet_annual_label_boundary_keeps_both_labels (DUPS: a Vardemangder list is not a sheet, so two labels of 001 are both kept and the repeated row is one member); test_missing_code_or_label_withholds_complete_list_only_where_member_applies[None-Label] (NOCODE: an undelivered Värdekod is unknown membership and withholds the list for the CVID's year); BLANK (maintainer decision 2026-10-09): a row delivering an empty code and an empty label is an export artifact, neither a member nor a missing code, so the list publishes without it and reports no issue, while the empty code labelled 'Uppgift saknas' is the member ""; test_conflicting_labels_preserve_agreed_codes_without_selecting_a_label (VERSIONS: two version names with equal members keep 001 and report only the label conflict; the withheld version label itself has no projection).
